note: Attacker-controlled SAV label length byte is read from the input stream and determines how many bytes of label data follow.
The parser derives the padded payload size from the attacker-controlled length, preserving the maliciously large label content.
The raw label bytes are copied into a temporary buffer and later converted into a heap-allocated UTF-8 string.

code: retval = readstat_convert(vlabel->label, utf8_label_len, label_buf, padded_label_len, ctx->converter)
note: The converted label string is stored in the value-label structure and becomes attacker-controlled heap data.
The metadata extractor duplicates the label into a new heap buffer using the string length from the parser callback.
The duplicated label length is recorded for later JSON emission.
The writer reuses the stored label pointer when serializing categories.
The sink emits the attacker-controlled label into output formatting; the crash is reached when malformed label metadata causes invalid memory access during serialization.
